## What's Changed

* gate the v3/v4 versions of MetricType by @alexanderkjall in https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/pull/1472

body.body:
Added the `cargo audit bin` subcommand to audit binaries compiled with [`cargo auditable`](https://github.com/rust-secure-code/cargo-auditable).

For now this requires the `binary-scanning` feature to be enabled at build time:

```
$ cargo install cargo-audit --features=binary-scanning
```
